name: BullReversalBarWithTail
longCondition: el_gt(close[0], open[0]) && el_ge(close[0] - low[0], closePositionMin * (high[0] - low[0])) && el_ge(open[0] - low[0], lowerTailMin * (high[0] - low[0]))
shortCondition: el_lt(close[0], open[0]) && el_ge(high[0] - close[0], closePositionMin * (high[0] - low[0])) && el_ge(high[0] - open[0], lowerTailMin * (high[0] - low[0]))
